**Finding: compliant** (no redline proposed).

The renewal mechanics sit in Section 13 "TERM OF AGREEMENT" (p0078), which is physically nested under the § 12 INDEMNITY section in this document:

- **Renewal term:** successive **one-year** periods — not multi-year, so no walk-away risk.
- **Notice window:** either party, including us as Client, may block renewal on written notice **30 days** prior to year end — this hits the *preferred* position (≤30 days) and is comfortably inside the fallback ceiling of 60 days.
- **Exit mechanics:** the opt-out is mutual and is supplemented by Section 14 (p0079), which lets Client terminate effective the last day of the month following notice — an additional customer-favourable exit.

Two minor sub-elements short of the preferred wording, noted in the rationale rather than flagged as deviations per the playbook's classification semantics:

1. No Vendor reminder 60 days before renewal.
2. No CPI/3% cap on renewal pricing — Section 6 (p0047) only freezes Hosting Services costs for the first year and adds a most-favoured-rate commitment, so post-year-one uplifts are uncapped.

Both can be raised as goodwill asks if renewal economics are otherwise negotiated, but neither justifies a redline on its own here.
